designs.name: 方案一·双角折锋
designs.design: Silhouette A — the light, elegant angular ram-horn bow. Each limb splits into TWO slender parallel polygon rails; near each shoulder these form one generous OPEN angular hook, a 4-segment horn sweep pointing forward to the left, then return into long graceful tapering recurved limbs. Upper and lower are coordinated and balanced. Horn gestures are abstract angular hooks, NOT a spiral disc or animal skull. Mostly hollow geometry with small triangular prism joints, two very sharp forked geometric tips, thin waist, generous negative space, carefully restrained number of components. Particle behavior: tiny coral triangular sparks peel away from the two shoulder hooks, curve in SHORT inward paths toward the grip, then fade before the clear central aiming space. Distinct few trails suggest converging motion. Emphasize agile twin horns and flowing geometry, not a chunky industrial frame.
designs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one premium fantasy weapon concept illustration for the RED ARIES bow in a twelve-zodiac Skyrim mod collection. Create ONE complete spectacular bow, isolated against charcoal black, tall portrait composition, fully visible tips, ample margins. Crisp side/very slight three-quarter view to show physical depth and the entire elegant recurved silhouette. It is a weapon made entirely of simple geometric forms and saturated self-luminous RED solid light: triangular prisms, straight narrow rails and polygon frames, clean repeatable modules. Crimson translucent-looking faces, scarlet luminous edges, restrained soft red bloom. The center has a slim practical grip with an OPEN arrow lane, NO star, NO hexagram, NO pentagram, NO magic circle, NO emblem, NO text or zodiac glyph. Express ARIES through paired angular horn-like projections and confident forward thrust, ABSTRACT straight-edged geometry, NOT a sculpted animal. Show the bow in a partly drawn charge state: a fine red luminous bowstring joins both tips and is pulled backward into a shallow V at the middle-right nocking point, no person and no arrow needed. Show tasteful, clearly visible animated-particle concept effects with tiny bright coral-red geometric flecks, short fading red trails and soft luminous points. Keep the particles distinct from the structure, sparsely concentrated around the limbs, never bury the silhouette or fill the aiming lane. Concept illustration with polished game-key-art presentation, tangible shape readability, sharp designed edges and rich red glow, not a wireframe CAD diagram. No blue, green, purple, gold, silver or white metal, no black metal material, no leather, no gears, no feathers, no flames or dense smoke, no organic textures, no lettering, no inset panels, no watermark.

Mostly hollow geometry with small triangular prism joints, two very sharp forked geometric tips, thin waist, generous negative space, carefully restrained number of components. Particle behavior: tiny coral triangular sparks peel away from the two shoulder hooks, curve in SHORT inward paths toward the grip, then fade before the clear central aiming space. Distinct few trails suggest converging motion. Emphasize agile twin horns and flowing geometry, not a chunky industrial frame.

designs.name: 方案二·层叠角冠
designs.design: Silhouette B — a powerful layered wedge bow. Build each limb from 9 overlapping solid elongated triangular prisms with alternating thin gaps, graduated large at the shoulders to very small at the tips; gradually rotate the prisms along a continuous sweeping recurve. TWO outward-leading faceted horn wedges frame the shoulders like an angular crown, the rest of the taper is clean and tight. A strong but slim geometric grip, compact center, bold double-stepped edges, no circular or spiral structures. The weapon reads as a beautifully balanced pair of geometric charging horns in full profile, broad shoulders and needle ends. Particle behavior: glowing little diamond shards and tiny flecks shed along the outside sawtooth edges; a subtle traveling red brightness pulse goes from the ends toward the center, visible as a few distinct brighter segments, no big halo. Emphasize imposing stacked depth and clean shape rhythm.

designs.name: 方案三·镂空锐翼
designs.design: Silhouette C — a long, lean, airy arrow-wing bow of OPEN acute triangles and chevrons. Each limb consists of 7 sweeping long hollow scalene triangle frames, interlocked tip-to-base along a deeply curved spine, with a second shorter row of offset chevrons. Sharply raked swept-back frames act as abstract slender ram horns, the upper and lower tips each diverge into a paired V-fork. Wide negative spaces, only narrow luminous geometric bars, no solid triangular plates and no coil or circular motif. Keep the center narrow and uncluttered, the overall silhouette very elegant and predatory, flatter shoulder transitions than variant B. Particle behavior: two slim ribbons of scattered bright red micro-sparks trace the outer limb curves; a few short angular streaks jump between neighboring triangle corners and fade, like geometric charge pulses. Show evident energetic motion while keeping the open framework clearly legible.
